opening.argument: The speaker directs viewers to join BitConnect through a referral link, promising that they can “get on my fucking team and make some money!” He separately urges immediate participation in the Electroneum token sale, tying free tokens and a 1% bonus to use of his referral link and presenting a conditional tenfold return. The video also shows an Electroneum purchase interface in which ETH is used to obtain a stated quantity of tokens, with a visible purchase button. These are direct invitations to participate in token opportunities framed around referral benefits, bonuses, and appreciation. A personal-account disclaimer and the speaker’s statement that “it's not a scam” qualify the presentation, and the available record does not establish completed payment, delivered tokens, profits, or viewer losses.
